Employee Benefits Administration Software by Paychex

Flock Benefits Administration by Paychex helps businesses simplify employee benefits administration, enrollment, and plan management through one centralized platform. You'll learn how employees can review and manage health, life, and disability insurance elections, multilingual support, interactive guidance, and self-service tools. Administrators gain visibility into enrollment activity and benefits utilization through a convenient dashboard, while automated carrier connections help reduce manual work and improve accuracy. No matter your business size, benefits administration software helps streamline benefits management while improving employee experience.

Topics:

  • 0:00 – Flock Benefits Administration Overview
  • 0:23 – Employee Enrollment and Broker Workflows
  • 1:01 – Customer Support and Contact Information

<p id="transcript-button">View Transcript</p>

Flock Benefits Administration Overview

0:01 Looking to simplify the maintenance of your employee benefits to attract and retain top talent. Paychex can help. Access to Flock Benefits Administration within Paychex Flex helps make benefits accessible and easy to manage for employees and administrators. Admins can check enrollment status and see how benefits are being used through a convenient benefits dashboard.

Employee Enrollment and Broker Workflows

0:24 Employees can manage all their benefit elections such as health, life and disability insurance. Thanks to Flock's intuitive workflows, Spanish translations, pop-up suggestions, in-app tutorials, and videos help them enroll at their own pace. Then save time and improve accuracy with automatic carrier connections for employee enrollments and updates. The same easy access and usability that Flock provides for employees and administrators is also available for insurance brokers with access to all clients from one centralized dashboard.

Customer Support and Contact Information

1:02 And if you ever have a question, you can count on our support team and your dedicated account manager for a personalized answer. Flock makes your job easier whether you employ five people or 5,000. To learn more about how Flock Benefits Administration by Paychex can help you, contact us today.

Simplify Employee Benefits Enrollment and Administration

Manage employee benefits, streamline enrollment, improve accuracy, and provide employees with an easier benefits experience through one centralized platform.

Explore Employee Benefits Solutions
